hamilton-2015-hot-core-chart.citation: Hamilton, Donohue, Hall, Leben, Quian, Sheinbaum and Watts (2015), Observations and Dynamics of the Loop Current, BOEM 2015-006, February 2015.
hamilton-2015-hot-core-chart.access: Original BOEM report acquired and SHA-verified. PDF277/printed247 Figure5.2-2 and extracted original 1098x906 chart actual pixels reviewed. Explicit Hot Core label and chart week. Manual pre-detachment lobe landmarks; native raster and published tick-label boxes verified on one idle local CPU. Not a closed eddy boundary or full outer extent.

records.period_label: EddyWatch week of 10-17 January 1986; pre-detachment lobe, not an exact survey time
records.case_label: Hot Core named source-chart frontal lobe; physical identity unverified
records.source_locator: BOEM2015-006 Figure5.2-2, printed247/PDF277; January10-17,1986 EddyWatch chart explicitly labels Hot Core Eddy. Section5.2, printed245/PDF275 gives January18 separation definition.
records.definition: Geographic east–west bounding span of manually selected extrema of the depicted Hot Core frontal lobe; eastern neck landmark excludes the Loop Current continuation.
records.scope: Pre-detachment source frontal lobe extent only. No detached full-eddy boundary, diameter or principal width inferred. Registry physical crosswalk unverified.
records.qualification: The eastern lobe-neck landmark is a declared manual boundary choice. Outline closure is unverified and no missing segments are reconstructed. Six original raster pixels at each extremum and outward 25km reporting are reading sensitivity only; junction ambiguity, scan distortion, frontal-analysis error and physical uncertainty remain unquantified. Source chart week is not an exact simultaneous observation; the separate January3-4 Ambassador transect and report January18 separation date are not substituted. Registry November8,1985 initial separation remains unreconciled. No EddyC alias, merged B/C loop diameter, Fast Eddy size, radius, area, footprint, state containment, rank or seasonal envelope inferred.
